name: Pahang Marathon 2026
short_description: A full and half marathon event held on September 6, 2026, at Dataran Sayangi Kuantan in Kuantan, Pahang, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Pahang Marathon 2026 is a road race scheduled for September 6, 2026, at Dataran Sayangi Kuantan in Kuantan, Pahang, Malaysia. It offers both a full marathon (42.195km) and a half marathon (21.1km) distance for participants to choose from. The event is organized by Persatuan Orang Muda Pahang KL (POMPKL) and Kita Pelari Malaysia, in partnership with Pure Events. Registration for the race is currently open.
